@graph.name: IV Glutathione Treatment
@graph.description: Glutathione IV Drip Treatment in Bangalore for Brighter, Healthier Skin! Safe, doctor-supervised IV Glutathione therapy for skin glow, detox, and anti-aging at
@graph.howPerformed: After a consultation and basic checks, glutathione with Vitamin C and other selected nutrients may be infused slowly through an IV under expert supervision. The Glow and Radiance Drip protocol includes ingredients such as Glutathione (1200 mg), Vitamin C (1000 mg), N-Acetyl Cysteine (400 mg), multivitamins and essential trace elements such as Zinc, Selenium and Copper, depending on the prescribed protocol. Each session generally takes around 45–60 minutes, allowing the infusion to be administered slowly and monitored for comfort and any potential reactions. Staying well hydrated before the session is recommended.

mainEntity.name: Is glutathione IV drip treatment safe?

acceptedAnswer.text: When administered under appropriate medical supervision, IV therapy is monitored throughout the session. Mild nausea, headache or discomfort at the injection site may occur in some individuals.

mainEntity.name: Who should avoid glutathione IV drips?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your doctor will review your medical history, allergies, existing health conditions and suitability before recommending an IV drip. A skin test or other basic checks may be advised where appropriate.

mainEntity.name: How long do the results last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Results vary from person to person and depend on individual skin concerns, lifestyle and the treatment protocol. Maintenance sessions may be recommended depending on your response and goals.

mainEntity.name: Is glutathione IV drip suitable for men?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Glutathione IV drip treatment may be considered for men as well as women, depending on their individual skin and wellness goals and medical suitability.
